title: THE WHOLE TOWN'S SECRET IS OUT! 😱

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: If this upload reaches one hundred percent, [beat] my parents are going to jail and our lives are officially over!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, I am trying to block the server, [beat] but this virus is spreading faster than a wildfire through every phone in the city!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: I just saw Dad's name on the leaked list, [beat] and next to it there is a folder titled 'Operation Tax Evasion 2022'!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Why is everyone screaming in here? [beat] Nix, why is my private banking password flashing on the living room television screen?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Dad, Principal Huda didn't just have school records; [beat] she had a secret surveillance file on every single adult in this neighborhood!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: That miserable woman! [beat] I knew she was a snake, but how did she get access to our private medical records and mortgage details?

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: It is not just Huda anymore! [beat] Someone hijacked her mainframe and they are broadcasting the entire database to the global web!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait... [beat] there is a folder here with your name on it, Joy, and it says 'Experimental Student Brainwashing Project'!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: What are you talking about? [beat] I thought I was just in the gifted program, not some freakish government science experiment!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: You students were never supposed to see those files, [beat] and now you have triggered a global kill-switch we cannot stop!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Mr. Kamal? You were in on this too? [beat] You are the one who helped Huda build this digital blackmail dungeon!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Huda was just a puppet, Nix. [beat] The real owners of this data are already standing outside your front door right now!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The screens went black as a heavy knock echoed through the house, [beat] and the town's darkest secrets were only the beginning.
